description: Get one Brazilian investment fund's share portfolio for a month, largest value first: each share's company and B3 symbol (when the share is a verified B3 listing), common, preferred or unit, shares held (counting shares lent out, also shown alone), value in reais, percentage of the fund's net assets and change in shares from the fund's previous month; with the fund's manager, asset class, net assets and the months it reported, from 2018. Only shares are listed, never the fund's bonds, fund units or derivatives. Funds may keep positions confidential for a few months, so by default it answers the fund's newest month that kept nothing confidential; a month that kept some confidential lists only part of the portfolio and says so. Find the fund with SearchBrazilianFunds.

fund.description: The fund's slug from SearchBrazilianFunds or GetBrazilianFundHoldings, its register number, or its exact name.

maxResults.description: Maximum positions, largest value first (default 50, max 100).

month.description: Optional month, YYYY-MM (e.g. 2026-04). Default: the fund's newest month that kept no share position confidential.

name: GetBrazilianFundPortfolio
title: Brazilian Fund Share Portfolio
